raw_meta_yaml:
# If `version` is changed but the base version is not, the build number must be incremented.
# Reset the build number to 0 if the base version is changed, for example from 5.6 to 6.0.
# The cgal-cpp C++ library and the cgal-swig-bindings release version diverged:
# the bindings are still at 6.0.1, but cgal-cpp moved on to 6.2. Only cgal-cpp
# >=6.1.2 has builds against libboost 1.90, so pin cgal-cpp independently of the
# bindings version to unblock the libboost 1.90 migration.
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: 6.0.1.post202410241521
  base_version: ${{ (version | split(".") | list)[:-1] | join(".") if (version | split(".") | list | length) > 3 else version }}
  cgal_cpp_version: "6.2"

package:
  name: cgal
  version: ${{ base_version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/CGAL/cgal-swig-bindings/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e9847d302d72a6e8735c7cf083f3ed02d3a4dc5389bbee628fbded768ff522d8
  patches:
    # cgal-cpp 6.2 requires Eigen 5, but the bindings' CMake uses
    # `find_package(Eigen3 3.x.y)`, which fails against Eigen >= 5 (its config
    # version file treats a single version as an exact match). Use a version
    # range + CONFIG mode so Eigen 5 is detected. Patch authored by
    # @diegoferigo-rai in conda-forge/cgal-feedstock#105.
    - patches/0001-support-eigen5.patch
    # CGAL >= 6.1 changed the Constrained_triangulation_plus_2 subconstraint
    # iterator value type; adapt the SWIG binding accordingly. Exact backport of
    # upstream cgal-swig-bindings commits 85d0d0a7 and f59e35dc (version-guarded
    # on CGAL_VERSION_NR so it still builds against CGAL < 6.1).
    - patches/0002-support-cgal61-subconstraint-api.patch
    # CGAL >= 6.2 deprecated Polygon_mesh_processing::border_halfedges() and moved
    # it to namespace CGAL, which both breaks the PMP:: call and makes the SWIG
    # wrapper's generated call ambiguous via ADL. Route to the new function and
    # give the wrapper a unique C++ name (still exposed as `border_halfedges`).
    - patches/0003-support-cgal62-border-halfedges.patch

build:
  # Cross-compiling free-threaded CPython (cp314t) to linux-aarch64 / linux-ppc64le
  # is unsupported here: CMake's FindPython cannot run the target interpreter, so it
  # fails to resolve the free-threaded Development.Module, silently drops the Python
  # bindings, and the emulated `import CGAL` test then fails. Skip only those two
  # cross free-threaded combinations; native linux-64 cp314t and every GIL-enabled
  # build (including aarch64/ppc64le) are retained.
  number: 6
  skip: is_freethreading and (aarch64 or ppc64le)

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: numpy
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: setuptools
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: wheel
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - cmake
    - if: unix
      then: make
    - if: win
      then: ninja
    # https://github.com/conda-forge/cgal-feedstock/pull/75#issuecomment-1305660884
    - swig <4.1
  host:
    - cgal-cpp ${{ cgal_cpp_version }}.*
    - eigen
    - libboost-devel
    - gmp
    - mpfr
    - numpy
    - python
    - setuptools
    - wheel
  run:
    - cgal-cpp ${{ cgal_cpp_version }}.*
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - CGAL
        - CGAL.CGAL_Kernel
        - CGAL.CGAL_Triangulation_2
        - CGAL.CGAL_AABB_tree
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -c "from importlib.metadata import version; assert version('cgal') == '${{ base_version }}'"

about:
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.GPL
    - LICENSE.COMMERCIAL
  summary: Computational Geometry Algorithms Library
  homepage: https://www.cgal.org/
  repository: https://github.com/CGAL/cgal-swig-bindings
  documentation: https://github.com/CGAL/cgal-swig-bindings/wiki
